name: Europe PMC API
description: Open-access REST API for biomedical/life-science literature. Returns JSON directly, no key required. resultType=core (added beyond the base query/format params) is required to get abstractText back — the default resultType=lite omits it.

name: PubMed E-utilities (esearch)
description: NCBI E-utilities esearch returns matching PMIDs as JSON, not full article metadata. app/services/paper_search.py follows up with a second, internal efetch call (XML, rettype=abstract) per batch of PMIDs to actually get title/abstract/authors/date — esearch alone can't populate those fields.

name: Semantic Scholar Graph API
description: Public/unauthenticated tier — returns JSON directly, no key required, but subject to a fairly aggressive shared rate limit (handled as a soft failure, logged, not fatal). publicationDate is included alongside year for a more precise date when available.

name: OpenAlex Works API
description: Open catalog of scholarly works. Keyless REST API returning JSON directly. Abstracts come back as an `abstract_inverted_index` (word -> position list) rather than plain text for copyright reasons; paper_search.py reconstructs the plain-text abstract from it.

name: Crossref REST API
description: Global DOI registration metadata API. Keyless REST returning JSON. Excellent for finding peer-reviewed article titles, publisher DOIs, publication dates, and author lists across all scientific publishers.

name: PLOS Search API
description: Public Library of Science Solr-backed REST API. Keyless and returns JSON directly. High-quality peer-reviewed biological, nutritional, and medical studies with clean, full abstracts.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov REST API v2
description: Official US NLM registry for human clinical trials. Keyless REST API returning structured JSON. Useful for identifying active and completed human efficacy/safety studies on specific supplement ingredients.

name: OpenAIRE Search API
description: European open-access scientific graph infrastructure. Keyless REST API returning JSON responses covering peer-reviewed open access papers and clinical datasets across Europe.

name: arXiv Query API
description: Open preprint repository. Keyless API returning Atom XML. Requires XML parsing in paper_search.py to extract title, summary (abstract), and authors for biochemistry/molecular biology preprints.

name: CORE API v3
description: Global open access repository aggregator. Public endpoint returning JSON containing paper titles, full abstracts, and repository links.

name: DataCite REST API
description: Global consortium API for DOIs, open datasets, clinical trials, and research publications. Keyless REST API returning structured JSON metadata including abstracts and publisher details.

name: DOAJ Articles Search API
description: Directory of Open Access Journals API. Keyless REST returning JSON with peer-reviewed open access papers across pharmacology, medicine, chemistry, and life sciences.

name: HAL Open Archive Search API
description: Major European open-access research repository. Solr-backed REST API returning JSON directly with complete author lists, full abstracts, and publication dates.

name: ChemRxiv Public API
description: Open preprint server for chemistry, biochemistry, bio-active compounds, and natural products. Keyless REST API returning JSON with paper abstracts and publication metadata.

name: Rxivist (bioRxiv/medRxiv API)
description: Indexed search API for bioRxiv and medRxiv preprints covering biomedical research, human clinical trials, and biochemistry. Keyless REST API returning JSON metadata.
